name: botrelay
description: A password manager built for AI agents. Give agents their own password vault, only the secrets they need, and the tools for secure access. BotRelay empowers agents to do more while keeping your secrets safe. Visit https://botrelay.ai for more information.

BOTRELAY_API_URL.title: BotRelay API URL
BOTRELAY_API_URL.description: BotRelay API base URL for this install.

BOTRELAY_API_KEY.title: BotRelay API Key
BOTRELAY_API_KEY.description: API Key for accessing the BotRelay vault.

BOTRELAY_VAULT_KEY.title: BotRelay Vault Key
BOTRELAY_VAULT_KEY.description: Key used to decrypts ciphertext locally.

BOTRELAY_PYTHON.title: Optional BotRelay Python Path
BOTRELAY_PYTHON.description: Optional. Path to the venv python that has botrelay-mcp installed (for example ~/.venvs/botrelay/bin/python3). Marketplace launch runs scripts/launch.sh and uses this path when it is set. If it is empty, or Shared MCP does not inject it, launch.sh tries botrelay-mcp on PATH, then ~/.venvs/botrelay/bin/python3, then python3 -m botrelay_mcp.
